datasets.name: Modified Swiss Dwellings (MSD)
datasets.attribution_text: Standfest, M., Franzen, M., Schröder, Y., Gonzalez Medina, L., Villanueva Hernandez, Y., Buck, J. H., Tan, Y.-L., Niedzwiecka, M., & Colmegna, R. (2022). Swiss Dwellings: A large dataset of apartment models. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7788422
datasets.wall_annotation_format: WKT Polygons (entity_type='separator', entity_subtype='WALL') and struct_in raster masks
datasets.drywall_notes: Generic structural and partition wall boundaries only. No US CSI drywall specifications.
datasets.eligibility_rationale: Permissive CC BY 4.0 commercial license, clean vector WKT polygons, compact download size (173.8 MB), and unauthenticated API access.
datasets.verification_method: Zenodo API, Hugging Face API, and 4TU verification
citations: Standfest et al., ECCV 2024 Workshop on Computer Vision for Architecture, Art and Design (CVAAD).

datasets.name: CubiCasa5K
datasets.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0 / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
datasets.attribution_text: Kalervo, A., Ylioinas, J., Häikiö, M., Karhu, A., & Kannala, J. (2019). CubiCasa5K: A Dataset for Floorplan Image Analysis. In International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.2613548
datasets.download_feasibility: Direct Open Zenodo CDN (Selective extraction recommended due to disk size)
datasets.wall_annotation_format: Vector SVG (<polygon class='Wall'>) and CAD raster renderings
datasets.drywall_notes: Generic residential wall outlines. No material or gypsum drywall distinction.
datasets.eligibility_rationale: Rich vector SVG wall polygons across 5,000 floor plans; highly eligible for academic evaluation and held-out benchmark validation. Non-commercial license prohibits unencumbered commercial deployment; full archive requires selective extraction to comply with host disk limits.
datasets.verification_method: Zenodo API and GitHub repository inspection

datasets.name: FloorPlanCAD
datasets.attribution_text: Zhi, R., Shen, H., Zheng, L., Wei, Y., & Zhang, H. (2021). FloorPlanCAD: A Large-Scale CAD Drawing Dataset for Panoptic Symbol Spotting. In ICCV.
datasets.download_feasibility: Hugging Face API test split (454 MB) / Google Drive (3.5 GB)
datasets.wall_annotation_format: Vector SVG primitives (Panoptic Stuff Class 0 Wall)
datasets.drywall_notes: Generic CAD wall linework in 20m x 20m crops. No drywall material verification.
datasets.eligibility_rationale: Annotations are CC BY-NC 4.0, but authors expressly disclaim copyright on underlying CAD drawings. Artificial 20m x 20m sub-drawing crops introduce boundary seam artifacts cutting continuous partitions.
datasets.verification_method: Official website disclaimer audit and Hugging Face API

datasets.name: CVC-FP
datasets.attribution_text: de las Heras, L.P., Valveny, E., & Ramos Terrades, O. (2015). CVC-FP database for structural floor plan analysis. Figshare DOI: 10.6084/m9.figshare.12082131.
datasets.wall_annotation_format: Vector SVG and binary PNG wall masks
datasets.drywall_notes: Generic structural and partition walls across 4 drafting styles. No drywall material properties.
datasets.eligibility_rationale: Permissive CC BY 4.0 license via Figshare, compact archive size (353.6 MB), and high-quality SVG/PNG masks. Ideal for CPU smoke testing and fast pipeline validation.
datasets.verification_method: Figshare API and Zenodo metadata verification
citations: de las Heras et al., CVC Technical Report 2015.

datasets.name: R2V (Raster-to-Vector)
datasets.license_name: Code MIT; Raster images strictly proprietary to LIFULL Co., Ltd.
datasets.attribution_text: Liu, C., Wu, J., Kohli, P., & Furukawa, Y. (2017). Raster-to-Vector: Revisiting Floorplan Transformation. In ICCV.
datasets.download_feasibility: Blocked / Gated (Requires NII IDR application & institutional contract)
datasets.wall_annotation_format: Vector text coordinates only; raster drawing images completely withheld
datasets.drywall_notes: No drywall material classification. Missing underlying raster images.
datasets.eligibility_rationale: Raster images are proprietary to LIFULL Co., Ltd. Access requires formal institutional legal contract via NII IDR. Autonomous download violates zero-license-acceptance rules; unusable without paired drawings.

datasets.name: SESYD Floorplans
datasets.attribution_text: Delalandre, M., Valveny, E., Trupin, P., et al. (2010). Generation of synthetic documents for performance evaluation of symbol recognition & spotting systems. IJDAR.
datasets.download_feasibility: Direct Open HTTP (~6 MB per subset)
datasets.wall_annotation_format: None (zero wall annotations; 16 symbol bounding boxes only)
datasets.drywall_notes: Walls are unannotated background raster noise.
datasets.eligibility_rationale: Fatal annotation defect: contains ground truth exclusively for 16 furniture/sanitary symbols. Zero wall annotations exist in dataset.
datasets.verification_method: Authoritative ground truth XML schema audit

datasets.name: ArchCAD-400k
datasets.attribution_text: Luo, J., et al. (2025). ArchCAD-400K: A Large-Scale CAD Drawings Dataset and New Baseline for Panoptic Symbol Spotting. arXiv:2503.22346.
datasets.download_feasibility: Blocked / Gated (Requires manual web application form and 3 business days approval)
datasets.drywall_notes: Standard CAD layer names without verified US CSI drywall specifications.
datasets.eligibility_rationale: Strictly gated behind manual Hugging Face application form requiring user's full name, institutional email, affiliation, and up to 3 business days review. Autonomous download violates zero-credential-acceptance rules.
datasets.verification_method: Hugging Face API gated parameter verification
